verdict.rationale: Fedora documents up-to-date packages, tools, runtimes and the latest container tools, and community users confirm it ships the newest software and works well as a Python development workstation. AI/ML support is thin: one user cites missing CUDA as a blocker, and nothing shows Fedora is a primary supported platform for major IDEs or ML frameworks. missing for 10: evidence of specific IDE availability, AI/ML framework and GPU (CUDA) support, and confirmation that Fedora is a primary supported platform for third-party developer tools.

support.subject: As a developer, I can use the latest IDEs, toolchains, and AI/ML software on a primary supported platform

citations.quote: All the packages, tools and runtimes you might need, up to date and ready for use with just a single command.
Use the latest container tools from the Red Hat ecosystem.
it became a full Python development workstation quickly
